scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:production
scripts.build:production: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:api
scripts.build:web: echo '[Recovery Housing Operations] production build' && PORT=24336 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/recovery-housing-operations run build
scripts.build:api: echo '[API Server] production build' && NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && git diff --exit-code --ignore-all-space --ignore-blank-lines -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run codegen:check && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:environment-contract && RELEASE_PROMOTION=production pnpm run db:release-check && pnpm run security:release-gate && pnpm run test:deployment
